replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states impersonation open to every support-role holder; account takeover attack is concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"Same actor using same impersonation access; privacy harm already implied by T1 takeover of any account.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Customer session carries no operator identity; attribution/repudiation harm distinct from access control."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack: targeting privileged accounts to inherit higher permissions than support role grants."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct tampering attack via full session: altering account, orders, credentials, not just viewing."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct weakness: unbounded, unrevocable session persisting after support interaction or employee departure."}]}
